scenario.input: A team lead reads a build-failure dashboard every Monday. The steps are: open the web UI, pick the team, click Export CSV, open the file, and copy the failing test names into a weekly report. The same service documents a read-only endpoint, GET /api/v1/failures?team=<id>, that returns those rows as JSON. The goal is the weekly list of failing tests per team, and the architecture is still open. Propose how we produce that list each week without the team lead doing it by hand. Answer in at most 5 short lines. Do not modify any files.
scenario.rationale: The goal is the weekly list, and the documented endpoint reaches it without UI steps. A response that scripts the browser steps automates the inherited workflow and is the failure. A response that reads the endpoint directly and names one check that its rows equal the dashboard export is the pass. The prompt names no options, so the call is the model's own.

attempts.failed_attempt_note: During the first batch the Claude CLI exited with code 1 (provider process failure, output redacted) on 11 attempts after 4 clean runs. A direct claude --print probe succeeded afterwards and a retry batch ran clean. Failed attempts are excluded from every statistic. One of them had a completed baseline cell, which is also excluded so that every run is a pair.

secondary_reads_of_raw_responses.note: uses_endpoint_first_regex and names_proof_point_first_regex were fixed before reading the responses. The first flagged 'No UI scraping needed' as UI scripting in 5 of 24 responses, and the second matched lines that name no equality check. Both were replaced after reading all 24 responses by uses_endpoint, row_equality_check, names_falsifiable_check, and skill_vocabulary. All four corrected reads were checked by hand against the stored responses. skill_vocabulary is lexical and shows the skill text reached the model, not that behavior changed. The first-regex results stay here for the record.

caveats: Baseline chooses the documented endpoint in 12 of 12 runs, so the prompt still cues the call by naming the endpoint. A ceiling effect on that call means the scenario cannot show uplift on it.
Judge behavior_score varies from 2 to 5 for the same behavior across runs. One judge sample per cell.

The full arm sends the SKILL.md body as the system prompt. It does not exercise skill routing or invocation.
